desc: The Winchester SXP Extreme Deer Hunter is a lightweight, instantly pointable and perfectly balanced pump action shotgun that is purpose built for the deer hunter. It features a 22" fully rifled barrel designed to take full advantage of modern sabot slugs and has a full dip treatment in Mossy Oak Break-Up Country to help you blend into almost any hunting environment. Need a follow-up shot? The Winchester SXP is the world's fastest pump action shotgun, with an inertia-assisted pump fully capable of three shots in half a second.
